in_sanskrit.name: दाताराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दाता (dātā) meaning giver, राम (rāma) meaning wealth or pleasure. So, Dataram means the one who gives wealth or pleasure.

in_hindi.name: दाताराम
in_hindi.meaning: दाता (dātā) meaning giver, राम (rāma) meaning wealth or pleasure. So, Dataram means the one who gives wealth or pleasure.

in_tamil.name: தாத்ராமம்
in_tamil.meaning: தாத்ரம் (tātraṃ) meaning giver, ராமம் (rāmam) meaning wealth or pleasure. So, Dataram means the one who gives wealth or pleasure.

in_telugu.name: దాతారామ

in_marathi.name: Dataram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dataram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dataram is derived from Sanskrit words ‘da’ meaning ‘give’ and ‘tram’ meaning ‘knowledge’. This name signifies the one who bestows the knowledge of the universe.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Dataram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Dataram is derived from Sanskrit words ‘da’ meaning ‘give’ and ‘tram’ meaning ‘knowledge’. This name signifies the one who bestows the knowledge of the universe.
